messages.subject: Time recording outstanding - November
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Our records show unposted time for November against several matters in your names. Please ensure all November time is recorded and released by close of business on Wednesday 3 December so we can run the month-end WIP report and December invoicing. Partners are asked to review draft bills on the Atlas and Kestrel matters in particular.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
